programmes.d: After forgetting to make a reservation at a popular restaurant he promised to take Audrey to, Jeff hatches a plan to get in anyway. Meanwhile, Liz and Russell attend a Sex Addicts Anonymous meeting.
When Brenda asks Audrey and Jeff to help cater an event at Columbia University, Audrey tries to impress those in attendance; Russell is angry when Timmy excludes him from a dinner.

Jeff and Audrey join Adam and Jen’s healthy cooking class, but it turns into a competition after Jen insults Audrey’s cooking. Meanwhile, Timmy is freaked out by his resemblance to Russell’s new girlfriend, Radha.
After Adam throws out his back on his 50th birthday, he is still determined to take a dirt bike excursion and check it off his bucket list; Don and Adam give out bonuses at work.
Adam gets jealous when Teddy names Andi as his hero for a school essay.
When Adam accidentally invites Andi to go on the guys' annual trip, he tries to un-invite her, which only makes matters worse.
Jen makes the guys plan a surprise bachelor party for Adam; Jen paints a graphic mural in Jeff and Audrey's nursery.
Jeff's plan to prove that Heidi, a college friend, never had feelings for him goes awry; after making a discovery, Timmy quits.
Jeff tries to make Brenda laugh about a pregnancy-related issue; while Timmy is surprised by his new boss's professionalism, Russell is frustrated with his new assistant.
Ray is mortified when he meets a girl he dated 25 years earlier.
All hell breaks loose when Robert starts dating a girl half his age.
Debra discovers that her seemingly contented parents are not happy.
Ray fears that he is going to come down with something dreadful.
Ray buys Debra an elaborate Christmas gift.
Ray questions his manliness.
Ray must choose who will accompany him to the Super Bowl.
Ray is mortified when he realizes that Marie used to read his journal.
Debra realizes that her and Ray, no longer have anything to say to one another.
Ray is upset when he discovers that his twins, are playing fairies in the school play.
Robert gets a surprise visit from Stefania.
Ray purchases a new state-of-the-art vacuum cleaner.
Tempers flare when Marie accuses Debra of not returning a canister.
Debra becomes angry when Ray contributes $1,000 to his friends' scheme.
Marie wants to understand why Robert can't commit to a relationship.
Ray realizes that his kids would rather spend time with Robert than with him.
Debra learns that her parents are planning to separate.

When Andi's doctor advises her to stop taking birth control pills, Adam and Andi disagree on an alternate option.
